mapper.sql: h.id, h.course_id, h.teacher_id, h.class_id, h.title, h.content, h.create_time, h.update_time, h.type, h.meta_data, 'homework' AS owner_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework (teacher_id, class_id, course_id, title, content, type, meta_data) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{classId}, #{courseId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{metaData})
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username AS teacher_name, c.name AS course_name FROM homework h LEFT JOIN users u ON h.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON h.course_id = c.id WHERE h.id = #{id}

SELECT , u.username AS teacher_name, c.name AS course_name FROM homework h LEFT JOIN users u ON h.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON h.course_id = c.id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND h.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY h.update_time DESC
